title: Read-Only LDAP and AD Enumeration Foundation
goal: Expand internal identity-aware coverage with a read-only LDAP and Active Directory enumeration runner that fits the existing evidence-first runner model.
scope: Implement the first coverage-expansion slice as a read-only LDAP and AD enumeration runner that discovers directory users, groups, privileged memberships, password-policy signals, and roastability indicators, then normalizes the result into existing inventory and findings structures. Keep cloud discovery and LLM-application probing out of scope for this slice.
generation_reason: Anti-drift hardening for the repo-backed post-intake backlog.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not promote or implement this task until the current task in NEXT_TASK.md is completed and logged.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Keep this slice to read-only LDAP and AD enumeration. Defer BloodHound, CrackMapExec, cloud configuration discovery, and LLM application probes.
notes: Normalize new identity findings into the existing finding model instead of creating a second identity-finding schema.
Keep the runner limited to approved internal or directory scopes and do not wire it into public web profiles.

success_criteria: A read-only LDAP or AD runner can collect users, groups, privileged memberships, SPN and AS-REP signals, and password-policy data.
The output is stored as evidence, normalized into inventory where appropriate, and surfaced as existing finding records where appropriate.
The slice remains safe and read-only, with no lateral-movement or exploitation behavior.
Runner and normalization tests cover zero-data, auth-failure, and partial-directory cases.
Documentation captures the read-only scope and explicitly defers cloud and LLM-application coverage.

acceptance_criteria: The runner never performs destructive, write, or privilege-escalation actions.
Identity-related inventory and findings remain visible through existing evidence and reporting flows.
The slice does not imply cloud discovery, IAM graphing, or LLM application testing support yet.

before_promotion: The active conversational-intake task in NEXT_TASK.md is completed, logged, and removed from active status.
python3 scripts/validate_backlog_tasks.py passes with this package still queued.
No exploitation-oriented AD tooling is introduced in this slice.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with the LDAP and AD enumeration slice and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the read-only identity coverage that now exists and the larger coverage gaps still pending.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md and rerun python3 scripts/validate_backlog_tasks.py.
